lines.text: Jesus asks Simon Peter three times if he loves Him, and each time tells him to feed or shepherd His sheep.
Peter is deeply hurt by the third question and answers that Jesus knows all things.
Jesus says that when Peter is old, someone else will dress him and lead him to Jerusalem, then tells him to follow.

wrong_details.true: where you do not want to go

lines.text: Peter asks Jesus about the disciple whom Jesus loved, and a rumor spreads among the brothers that he would not marry.
The disciple whom Jesus loved testifies to these things and wrote them down, and his testimony is true.
